note: Transcribed verbatim from the owner's reference instrument (G-27). Covers the 15 of 51 catalogued objectives that carry question text there; the rest are recorded for a reviewer and say so on screen.

objectives.name: Access Management & Authorization
objectives.text: Is logical access to systems and data formally authorized, documented, and restricted based on role and least-privilege need?
objectives.objective: Ensure logical access to systems and data is formally authorized, documented, and restricted based on role and least privilege.

children.text: Are documented access-control policies and procedures established and maintained?
Are logical access restrictions defined, documented, approved, and enforced?
Is there a process to authorize logical access consistent with role and business need?
Is access to enterprise environments and data restricted to managed / compliant (organization-owned) devices, and is organizational data prohibited on unmanaged / BYOD endpoints?

objectives.name: Multi-Factor Authentication
objectives.text: Is multi-factor authentication (MFA) enforced or available for access to systems and data?
objectives.objective: Ensure multi-factor authentication is enforced for access to systems and data commensurate with resource sensitivity.

children.text: Is MFA enforced (vs. only available) for user access?
Is MFA required for vendor / third-party staff accessing systems?

objectives.name: Privileged Access Management
objectives.text: Is privileged / administrative access restricted, separated, and subject to stronger controls than standard access?
objectives.objective: Ensure privileged and administrative access is restricted, separated, and subject to stronger controls than standard access.

children.text: Is MFA required for privileged / administrative account access?
Is MFA required for non-privileged account access?
Are replay-resistant authentication mechanisms implemented for privileged access?
Is a session lock retained until the user re-establishes access via identification / authentication?
Is administrator-level authorization required for modifying audit logs / audit configuration?
Are accounts locked after a defined number of consecutive invalid login attempts (account lockout; NIST AC-7)?

objectives.name: Access Review & Recertification
objectives.text: Are access rights periodically reviewed and recertified to confirm they remain appropriate?
objectives.objective: Ensure access rights are periodically reviewed and recertified to confirm they remain appropriate.

children.text: Are access-management controls in place and described (who reviews, how often, evidence)?

objectives.name: Access & Credential Lifecycle
objectives.text: Are user access and credentials provisioned, changed, and de-provisioned through a controlled lifecycle?
objectives.objective: Ensure user access and credentials are provisioned, changed, and de-provisioned through a controlled lifecycle.

children.text: Is there a defined process to build / provision users for system access?
Are user credentials securely communicated for first-time use and after account changes?
Are processes in place to rotate access tokens, keys, and passwords per standard?

objectives.name: Remote Access
objectives.text: Are remote-access methods governed with documented usage restrictions, configuration / connection requirements, and monitoring?
objectives.objective: Ensure remote-access methods are governed with documented usage restrictions, connection requirements, and monitoring.

objectives.name: Encryption (In Transit & At Rest)
objectives.text: Is sensitive data protected through encryption in transit and at rest in accordance with enterprise standards?
objectives.objective: Establish, implement, and maintain encryption standards to protect sensitive data in transit and at rest.

children.text: Is data encrypted in transit / in-motion per enterprise standards?
Is data encrypted at rest per enterprise standards?
Does encryption meet industry best-practice / enterprise strength standards?
Is encryption required when storing and transmitting passwords / credentials?
For AI/GenAI use, is data encryption implemented at-rest and in-transit for inputs / outputs and supplemental data?

objectives.name: Data Minimization & De-identification
objectives.text: Is data limited to only what is needed for the activity (data minimization)?
objectives.objective: Ensure data is limited to only what is necessary for the activity (data minimization), with justification for any sensitive data.

children.text: Are enterprise standards used to anonymize test data derived from production?
Is data de-identified or anonymized where appropriate (e.g., non-production use, analytics, sharing)?

objectives.name: Retention, Deletion & Disposal
objectives.text: Is data retained only as long as required and securely disposed of, with disposal verified?
objectives.objective: Ensure data is retained only as long as required and securely disposed of, with disposal verified.

children.text: Does the activity follow the enterprise data retention policy?
Is system media protected until it is destroyed or sanitized using approved methods?
Are data-management / privacy controls (flow enforcement, protection at rest) in place per framework?

objectives.name: Secrets & Configuration Protection
objectives.text: Are credentials, secrets, keys, and sensitive configuration protected against unauthorized access and modification?
objectives.objective: Ensure credentials, secrets, keys, and sensitive configuration are protected against unauthorized access and modification.

children.text: Are software and application security configurations backed up and protected against unauthorized modification?
Are sensitive data attributes (e.g., PI-Fraud Sensitive) protected using an enterprise-recognized method of attribute obfuscation?
Are security configurations reviewed periodically, approved for significant changes, and prior versions retained per the records retention schedule?

objectives.name: Media Protection
objectives.text: Is physical and removable media containing sensitive data protected during storage, use, and transport?
objectives.objective: Ensure physical and removable media containing sensitive data is protected during storage, use, and transport.

children.text: Is encryption used to protect confidentiality / integrity of information on media?
Is digital and non-digital media physically controlled and securely stored within controlled areas?

objectives.name: Boundary Protection & Segmentation
objectives.text: Are network boundaries protected and segmented to control traffic and prevent unauthorized access?
objectives.objective: Ensure network boundaries are protected and segmented to control traffic and prevent unauthorized access.

children.text: Are routers, firewalls, encrypted tunnels, etc. used to control network communications?

objectives.name: WAF / External Endpoint Protection
objectives.text: Are externally exposed endpoints protected by a web application firewall / API gateway?
objectives.objective: Ensure externally exposed endpoints are protected by web application firewall and API gateway controls.

objectives.name: API & Interface Security
objectives.text: Are APIs and system interfaces / integrations secured through approved, benchmarked, and monitored configurations?
objectives.objective: Ensure APIs and system interfaces are secured through approved, benchmarked, and monitored configurations.

children.text: Are software / application (including interface) configurations aligned to industry-recognized security benchmarks (e.g., CIS, NIST, vendor best practices) and documented / approved?
Are interface / application configurations tested prior to implementation and scanned / monitored for misconfiguration and configuration drift?
Are network access connections controlled and boundary protection rules configured and maintained for systems exposing the interfaces / APIs?
Are interface / application and network events configured to alert, log, and monitor per the Security logging standard?

objectives.name: Availability / DoS Protection
objectives.text: Are controls in place to protect against or limit the effects of denial-of-service conditions?
objectives.objective: Establish and maintain controls to protect against and limit the effects of denial-of-service conditions.
